title: The Middleware Onion State Leak
pattern: Building long chains of deeply nested middleware/interceptors that rely on mutating a shared implicit context object.
why_bad: Hidden state dependencies. It is impossible to determine the control flow because execution relies on implicit ordering of onion layers.
detection: Chains of interceptors reading and writing untyped values from a shared request context.
counterexample: Middleware that only performs logging, authentication checks, or context-independent operations.
fix: Replace implicit context maps with explicit typed data structures passed between layers.
source: Heather Adkins et al., *Building Secure and Reliable Systems*, Chapter 12.
